# Roma Cultural Resources

Initial source gathering: 2026-11-05. These resources support informed, non-monolithic portrayals; they are not a sourcebook for turning real Roma culture into fantasy decoration. The Vistani are fictional and are not interchangeable with Roma communities.

## RomArchive

- **Source:** [RomArchive](https://www.romarchive.eu/en/), including its [about page](https://www.romarchive.eu/en/about/) and [ethical guidelines](https://www.romarchive.eu/en/about/ethical-guidelines/); archive and about pages consulted on 2026-11-05.
- **What it offers:** A curated digital archive with sections including literature, film, music, dance, theatre, visual arts, civil-rights history and testimony. Its collection policy and ethical guidelines help explain provenance and representation.
- **Potential use:** Discover Roma artists, writers, histories and self-representations rather than relying only on outside depictions. Use item-level credits and permissions; rights vary across the archive.

## ERIAC - *Guidelines on the Promotion of Roma Identity, History, and Culture* (2026)

- **Source:** [ERIAC resource page](https://eriac.org/guidelines-on-the-promotion-of-roma-identity-history-and-culture/); page overview consulted on 2026-11-05; the linked guideline PDF was not reviewed for this gathering.
- **What it offers:** A multi-country initiative's guidance that foregrounds Roma authorship, agency, diversity, participation and public memory rather than reducing Roma representation to victimhood.
- **Potential use:** A check against flattening a fictional traveling people into one trait, role or story. For deeper use, read the linked guidance and cite its authors and project accurately.

## ERIAC - *Advancing Romani Media Representation and Production in Europe and Beyond* (2025)

- **Source:** [ERIAC resource page](https://eriac.org/advancing-romani-media-representation-and-production-in-europe-and-beyond-a-position-paper/); page overview consulted on 2026-11-05; the linked position-paper PDF was not reviewed for this gathering.
- **What it offers:** A position paper describing how media narratives can reinforce stigma and calling for Roma participation in media creation and decision-making.
- **Potential use:** Review a Vistani scene or character for agency, individuality, and control over how the story represents the group. It is representation guidance, not a catalogue of cultural details to borrow.

## Use in this campaign

Consult these sources when reviewing Vistani portrayals, especially where a scene relies on familiar stereotypes about itinerant groups, fortune-telling, criminality, exoticism or collective behavior. Keep the campaign's established Vistani facts as canon, distinguish them from real Roma cultures, and prefer Roma-authored material for contemporary cultural perspectives. Do not infer a character's beliefs or behavior from ethnicity alone.
